title: SliceSpec Annotation
description: Annotation metadata for a SliceSpec: source instruction, context files, and invariant references

sliceId.description: The slice ID this annotation belongs to

sourceInstruction.description: Index or reference of the source user instruction that produced this spec

contextFiles.description: File paths used as context when generating this spec

invariantRefs.description: Hard-constraint numbers referenced by this spec (e.g. ["C1","C3","C5"])
